description: 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부_우편집중국간 차량운송집계데이터 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. 2019년 10월 집중국간 차량운송데이터(발송집중국, 도착집중국, 운송거리 등)에 대한 정보입니다. 2019년 10월 한 달간 우정사업본부의 우편집중국 간 차량운송 데이터이며, 전국적으로 총 27,757회의 차량 운송이 이루어졌으며, 이를 통해 이동한 거리는 총 6,174,891km에 달합니다. 이 기간... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. Its tags are 우정사업본부, 우편집중국, 차량운송, 물류 데이터, 운송거리. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-08-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
